text:
This dental clinic doesn't value dental health.

Two or three of my relatives have used their services for toothaches. Every time, the dentist extracted the tooth on the first visit, without suggesting or recommending other possible treatments, such as root canal treatment. This is despite the fact that the extracted tooth could have been saved, leaving the patient with a missing tooth and unnecessary loss of a tooth that cannot grow back.

Therefore, I do not recommend this clinic for anyone experiencing toothache, as they may end up with an unwanted extraction when other treatments might be possible.
